feedback.stale: Refresh failed. The last snapshot is retained and may be stale.

local.pointLimits: Inference requires a complete explicitly non-optimized standard DB: BOOL, supported scalars, STRUCT/acyclic UDT and one-dimensional arrays. STRING, unknown types, optimized or incomplete sources reject the entire DB. Manual addresses are always preserved.

local.structure: Complete structure tree and source lines
local.assignFiltered: Enable filtered points in this group

local.importConfirm: Save the previewed import? Structure changes invalidate affected address confirmations; previous manual values remain for comparison.
local.offsetConfirm: Confirm inferred offsets for the complete flat standard DB? Manual addresses remain protected.
local.retentionNote: Only expired complete, acknowledged and unreferenced cycles can be reclaimed. Pending samples are never deleted for quota or age. Warn at 80%, stop at 90%, resume below 70% with healthy storage and free space.
local.bootstrapFailed: Runtime mode could not be confirmed. Console loading stopped; inspect local startup logs.

local.controlTargetsConfirm: Apply this action to these {count} fixed PLC targets? Each reports independently.
local.staleSnapshot: Snapshot refresh failed. Showing the last successful snapshot generated at {time} (Asia/Shanghai).
local.saveApplyHint: Activate explicitly after saving. Connect and collect separately in the workbench.
local.testActiveHint: Connection tests use the active configuration. Unsaved endpoints are not tested.
local.editHint: Save draft persists these edits. Failed saves keep your input; Cancel writes nothing. Connection and collection require separate actions.
local.sourceHelp: Files are identified automatically. Enter each actual DB number, select blocks, then preview the delta. UDTs have no DB number. Existing blocks update only with valid source proof; renumbering, renaming or leaf removal is blocked. For changed sources, explicitly select an existing target. Unselected blocks retain their old versions.
local.capacityRisk: Storage admission is closed and new collection is paused. Check capacity or storage faults.
local.runtimeActiveHint: Operations use the active configuration. Connect before collecting; pausing keeps the connection.
local.historyNotLoaded: Query locally persisted history to load it.
local.finishEditing: Save draft or Cancel in the open editor before other configuration actions.
local.saveBeforeTools: Finish editing and save the draft before previewing or confirming sources or offsets.
local.discardEditorConfirm: Discard the unfinished edits and switch page?
local.workflowHint: Save PLC → import points and assign groups → explicitly apply configuration → connect and collect in Workbench.
local.historyTimezone: Inputs and display use {timezone}. Saved time is persistence transaction time; the end includes every millisecond of the selected second.
local.historyEnd: End of the query results. You can return to the previous page.
local.historyCursorBounded: You have reached the earliest page available here. Search again to browse from page 1.
local.desktopPreviewHelp: Open the desktop app with pnpm tauri dev. Preview provides navigation, theme and language only.
local.retiredKeys: Retired environment keys ignored; SQLite owns business configuration

migration.failedHint: Legacy-source migration failed; view details for an allowed retry.
migration.unknownHint: Migration persistence is unknown; it cannot be claimed as remembered. Repair storage/logging and reopen.
migration.title: Current migration failure
migration.failed: Legacy-source migration failed; retry only when currently allowed.
migration.boundary: SQLite owns configuration; YAML is a one-time source. PLCs, groups and points were disabled at migration, with unconfirmed addresses and incomplete DB structure. These historical records do not describe later edits. Explicitly import and review .db/.udt before separate activation, connection and collection.

migration.persistenceUnknown: Migration status could not be persisted; import success is not claimed. Repair storage/logging and reopen.
migration.unsaved: Save or cancel current edits before retrying so unsaved changes are retained.
migration.details: Sources, diagnostics and receipt at migration
migration.example: Application defaults at migration referred to sanitized repository examples and created disabled candidates, not site configuration.
